'''Tomlas Ore''' was a [[Virella Systems]] [[Virella Systems cargo freighter|Cargo freighter]] that was present at [[Camen Spaceport]] where the [[Hurrim]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class T-4a shuttle]] [[Merte]], stolen by two members of [[Dunari]]'s coalition escaped the Hurrim's asteroid base under heavy pursuit of [[Preybird-class starfighter|Preybird]] starfighters. [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] sent a strike force of two [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] to cover the retreat. Until the shuttle reached hyperspace. The Cargo Freighter's entire cargo Containers carried Smelted Ore.
